title: The generic HDF5 representation of a ResultBundle
note: H1-H8: each disagreement between the structured view, the record, the stated digest and the artefact bytes is refused; authority is never claimed. H9 to H31 (AUD-053): the library reads in a child process. A child that dies by a signal or runs out of time is a refusal of the file; one that ends any other way, or whose answer does not hold to itself, is the reader's fault and never a refusal; the child is isolated from its caller's directory and environment, stands in a directory of its own, and compiles where its parent was told to. Each is held by a test that stands a program of its own in the child's place, so none depends on a file that breaks one build of the library.

mutations.name: H1_value_unchecked
mutations.rationale: an output value edited in the structured view reads back as the record

mutations.name: H2_attrs_unchecked
mutations.rationale: a changed unit or resolution attribute passes

mutations.name: H3_digest_unchecked
mutations.rationale: a rewritten record passes as the stated bundle

mutations.name: H4_raw_artifact_unchecked
mutations.rationale: artefact bytes not their digest pass

mutations.name: H5_authority_claim_accepted
mutations.rationale: a file claiming authority is read

mutations.name: H6_parameters_unchecked
mutations.rationale: an edited parameter passes

mutations.name: H7_invariants_unchecked
mutations.rationale: a flipped invariant passes

mutations.name: H9_the_library_reads_in_the_readers_own_process
mutations.rationale: the reader as it was: the library reads in the reader's own process, its errors named as before, and a file that makes it fault kills the reader, and one that makes it loop holds it (AUD-053)

mutations.name: H10_a_child_killed_by_a_signal_is_the_readers_fault
mutations.rationale: a file that kills the library is reported as the reader's failure and not refused as a file

mutations.name: H11_a_signal_without_a_name_raises
mutations.rationale: a child killed by a signal the interpreter has no name for raises ValueError out of the reader

mutations.name: H12_a_read_has_no_deadline
mutations.rationale: a file that makes the library loop holds its reader for as long as it loops

mutations.name: H13_a_child_out_of_time_raises_the_librarys_timeout
mutations.rationale: a read that ran out of time raises subprocess.TimeoutExpired where the reader refuses

mutations.name: H14_a_child_that_failed_is_asked_for_its_answer
mutations.rationale: a child that ended with a traceback is read for an answer, and its exit status and what it said are lost

mutations.name: H17_an_answer_that_is_not_an_object_is_read_as_one
mutations.rationale: an answer that is a list is indexed as an object, and the fault names a TypeError and not what was wrong

mutations.name: H18_a_childs_refusal_is_not_raised
mutations.rationale: a file the child refused is reported as the reader's failure, and no caller handling refusals sees it

mutations.name: H19_the_bundle_the_child_named_is_believed

mutations.name: H23_the_child_is_not_isolated
mutations.rationale: the child imports whatever stands in its caller's directory or is named by its environment

mutations.name: H24_the_child_compiles_beside_the_source
mutations.rationale: the child ignores where its parent was told to keep bytecode, and can run a stale cache of the module it reads with

mutations.name: H25_the_child_writes_bytecode_its_parent_was_told_not_to
mutations.rationale: the child writes bytecode beside the source in a run that was told to write none

mutations.name: H26_a_library_error_in_the_child_is_a_traceback
mutations.rationale: a file with corrupt metadata is the reader's failure with a traceback, where it was a refusal naming the library's error

mutations.name: H29_links_that_are_a_string_are_one_a_character
mutations.rationale: a child that answers its links as one string is read as sixty-four links of one character each

mutations.name: H30_the_child_stands_where_its_caller_does
mutations.rationale: what a child leaves, the core file of a fault among it, lands in its caller's directory

mutations.name: H31_a_relative_path_is_read_from_the_childs_directory
mutations.rationale: a path relative to the caller is looked for where the child stands, and a file that is there is refused as missing
